name: Tia-Clair Toomey-Orr
who: Eight-time CrossFit Fittest Woman on Earth who now races Hyrox mixed doubles, pairing with husband Shane Orr and with CrossFit star James Newbury.
why: The most decorated CrossFitter alive racing Hyrox doubles brings the whole CrossFit fanbase along with her.

name: James Newbury
who: Five-time CrossFit Games athlete and CrossFit Games Team champion, former semi-pro rugby player, now racing Hyrox Elite 15 doubles.
why: Podiums with Toomey in mixed doubles make him one of the clearest CrossFit-to-Hyrox pipelines to watch.

name: Mat Fraser
who: Five-time CrossFit Games champion (2016-2020) who came out of retirement to race Hyrox doubles in New York and Las Vegas.
why: The most dominant CrossFitter ever taking Hyrox seriously, on camera, is the single biggest crossover storyline the sport has right now.

name: Laura Horvath
who: 2023 CrossFit Games champion and three-time Rogue Invitational winner who raced Hyrox mixed doubles with her brother Kristof at the 2026 World Championships (58:43).
why: One of CrossFit's biggest current stars showing up on a Hyrox start line pulls a fresh audience toward the sport.

name: Willy Georges
who: Leading French CrossFit Games athlete and former rugby player who raced Hyrox Pro Men at the 2026 World Championships, ranking first in the sled push.
why: Brings France's CrossFit following to Hyrox and shows raw strength translates directly to the sled stations.

name: Kristi Eramo O'Connell
who: Seven-time CrossFit Games competitor who retired from CrossFit and won her Hyrox pro debut in Houston, then took Mixed Doubles in Dallas.
why: A CrossFit veteran who didn't just dabble in Hyrox — she won straight out of the gate and kept winning.

name: Jonne Koski
who: Finnish CrossFit-scene veteran who teamed up with Olympic cross-country skiing champion Iivo Niskanen for a Hyrox doubles debut in Helsinki (Pro Doubles 30-34, 58:02).
why: The Koski-Niskanen pairing pulled Finland's ski and CrossFit crowds into a Hyrox stream at the same time.

name: Iivo Niskanen
who: Three-time Olympic cross-country skiing champion who raced his first Hyrox doubles event in Helsinki alongside CrossFit's Jonne Koski.
why: One of Finland's biggest sporting names trying the format on camera brings mainstream endurance-sport eyes to Hyrox.

name: Kris Rugloski
who: Spartan and Tough Mudder OCR champion — first woman to complete 100 miles at World's Toughest Mudder — and the 2022 Hyrox World Champion, still racing Elite 15 today.
why: Living proof that OCR toughness transfers straight to Hyrox gold, and she never left the elite scene.

name: Nick Bare
who: Former US Army officer and the biggest name in hybrid-fitness content, who raced Hyrox Pro in Dallas and finished 9th of 207.
why: His podcast and video breakdown of training for and racing Hyrox is many newcomers' first real look at the sport.

name: Mirjam Von Rohr
who: Reigning Swiss, European, and World Functional Fitness Champion and 2024-25 CrossFit Open winner who raced Hyrox Pro Women for Switzerland, finishing 7th at the 2026 World Championships.
why: A genuine multi-discipline champion — CrossFit, weightlifting, powerlifting — adding Hyrox pulls functional-fitness diehards along with her.

name: Noah Ohlsen
who: Multi-time CrossFit Games veteran, 2019 Games runner-up and 'Spirit of the Games' award winner, who raced Hyrox Elite Doubles at the 2026 World Championships.
why: One of CrossFit's most respected names lends the format his credibility and his built-in following.

name: Hong Beom-seok
who: Physical:100 season-two runner-up and former South Korean special-forces soldier and firefighter who has raced Hyrox Seoul and Hyrox Singapore, taking 2nd in doubles with SHINee's Minho.
why: His military-toughness fame from Physical:100 is exactly the audience Hyrox wants watching a race.

name: Choi Min-ho
who: SHINee member and actor, known as Minho, who raced Hyrox Singapore's Men's Doubles alongside Physical:100's Hong Beom-seok, finishing 2nd.
why: A K-pop idol podiuming at Hyrox is the kind of mainstream press the sport cannot buy.

name: Anne Curtis
who: Filipino actress and TV host who raced Hyrox Seoul with husband Erwan Heussaff as a celebrity-couple entry.
why: One of the Philippines' biggest media stars racing Hyrox brings a huge Southeast Asian audience with her.

name: Erwan Heussaff
who: Entrepreneur and media personality who completed Hyrox Seoul as part of a celebrity-couple entry with wife Anne Curtis.
why: A Philippine lifestyle-media heavyweight actually finishing Hyrox is free exposure to an audience the sport hasn't reached yet.

name: Nico Bolzico
who: Argentine-born fitness entrepreneur and Philippine media personality who completed his Hyrox debut in Seoul in 1:16 alongside the country's fastest Hyrox Pro racer.
why: A fitness-focused celebrity who trained and actually finished, not just showed up for photos.

name: Dong Hyun Kim
who: Former UFC welterweight ('Stun Gun') who anchored Team South Korea to victory at the Hyrox x Stan Browney creator race.
why: A legit ex-UFC fighter winning a Hyrox creator event shows the format rewards real athletic pedigree, not just influencer clout.
